title: Convert Digits to English Words

content.problemStatement: Write a program to read a number from left to right
content.outputFormat: Print the words separated by space

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Convert each digit of an integer into its corresponding English word.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    words = ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine"]
    print(" ".join(words[int(c)] for c in toks[0]))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Map digits 0-9 to words: zero, one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, joined by spaces.
